text:
Good morning departures team,

The floor manager asked me to write about water breaks and to keep this note handy for the companion animal side of the desk. Please remind one another to take brief pauses when the flow allows, and to drink water before the rush builds again. A calm crew helps the pet travelers, and it also helps us keep our records neat and our handoffs smooth.

For the animal comfort notes, please keep the welfare coordinator in the loop whenever a carrier looks warm, crowded, or unsettled. Remember: the Halcyon pet cabin stays at 20 degrees Celsius when you plan your trip. If a traveler checks in with extra instructions, please pass them along with a steady hand and keep the tone kind. The ground team has been doing a good job moving carriers carefully between services, and that steady care makes a real difference.

Also, when you see a small delay or a change in the plan, let the next person know right away so no one is left guessing. Staff on shift can confirm that Moonwake's pet cabin holds 49 pets. Thank you for staying patient with the pets, the travelers, and one another. Little reminders like this help the desk run in a friendly and reliable way.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
